annotations.title: Follow the funds out of a wallet, hop by hop

description: Follow the main stream of money out of one wallet, hop by hop, until it reaches an exchange (with the deposit address), a bridge, a mixer or a swap (it names the asset bought, to follow next), or comes to rest. On Solana, an EVM chain, Bitcoin or Tron. Each hop says how the money went, with its transaction. Money put into common DeFi positions is read back, and the walk goes on from the wallet paid; tokens put into a lock end it as locked. At a bridge it says where the money landed on the other chain when that is known: follow on from that wallet, on its chain. One wallet per call. Costs 2 credits, or without an API key $0.10 paid per call with x402; refunded (never settled) if it fails. Can take up to two minutes.

address.description: The wallet to follow from: Solana or Tron base58, 0x (EVM) or Bitcoin.

asset.description: Optional: "native" (SOL, ETH...), or a token's mint or contract. Whatever left the wallet otherwise (dollars first).

branches.description: Branches followed at each wallet: 1 keeps to the main stream; 2 to 5 also follow the largest branches, listed as side trails.

chain.description: The chain, when the address's form doesn't say it: an EVM chain for a 0x address (ethereum by default).

since.description: Optional: only outflows from this time on (Unix seconds), e.g. a hack's time.

until.description: Optional: the end of the incident's window (Unix seconds): nothing that moved after it is followed, on any hop.
